en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a large hilltop castle-like building labeled as Schloss Bieberstein, overlooking a wooded slope and a rocky river or stream in the foreground. Tall trees and dense foliage surround the hillside, with the multi‑storey structure rising above the treetops. The image has an early 20th‑century photographic style and printed captions along the top and right edges.
